# Superpowers skills

These skills are from [obra/superpowers](https://github.com/obra/superpowers), installed for native VS Code Copilot skill discovery. The skill files and supporting resources are unchanged from upstream revision `2ce8aa15d05bd57213e6f746f953aafb7ded7a8b`.

The upstream repository is MIT-licensed; see [LICENSE](./LICENSE). Plugin manifests and lifecycle hooks are not installed here. Review upstream changes before updating these vendored files.

The [frontend-design](./frontend-design/SKILL.md) skill is from [anthropics/claude-plugins-official](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-plugins-official/tree/a7ba5b93db0c7c8d17f3f1d25853adca79598a1a/plugins/frontend-design), revision `a7ba5b93db0c7c8d17f3f1d25853adca79598a1a`. It is installed in VS Code's native skill format; its Apache 2.0 terms are included in [frontend-design/LICENSE.txt](./frontend-design/LICENSE.txt).

The [code-review-skill](./code-review-skill/SKILL.md) is from [awesome-skills/code-review-skill](https://github.com/awesome-skills/code-review-skill/tree/4850184dfd7765ea7b3c5c4e9b6cf8e0815ee7cb), revision `4850184dfd7765ea7b3c5c4e9b6cf8e0815ee7cb`. Its review references, checklist assets, and optional PR diff analyzer are included; the upstream MIT license is in [code-review-skill/LICENSE](./code-review-skill/LICENSE).
